title: In silico screening and identification of potential drug against p300 acetyltransferase activity in breast cancer via drug repurposing approach.
authors: Sarkar, Shilpi; Kandasamy, Thirukumaran; Shome, Rajib; Ghosh, Siddhartha Sankar
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟筛选靶向p300乙酰转移酶的潜在药物，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且未聚焦TF-DNA结合机制，仅方法部分可借鉴。
abstract: Emerging evidence portray the involvement of epigenomic reprogramming in the onset and progression of several malignancies, including breast cancer. Histone acetyltransferase (HAT) p300 is a critical epigenetic regulator that acts as a transcription co-activator and regulates various cellular processes. p300 is overexpressed in breast cancer and promotes cellular invasion and survival, making it a promising druggable target. In this study, the relevance of p300 in different cancer pathways was established. Virtual screening of the FDA-approved drug library was carried out using molecular docking, and the top 10 potential repurposed drugs were identified. Further, recalculation of binding free energy of drug-p300 complexes was carried out using molecular mechanics Poisson-Boltzmann and surface area (MM-PBSA) method after molecular dynamic simulation. Based on molecular dynamic simulation parameters and binding free energy analysis, two drugs, namely Netarsudil (-305.068 kJ/mol) and Imatinib (-260.457 kJ/mol), were identified as potential repurposed drugs to inhibit the activity of p300. In conclusion, these findings suggest, Netarsudil and Imatinib might be a potential repurposed drug to combat breast cancer via p300 inhibition.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 新兴证据表明，表观基因组重编程参与包括乳腺癌在内的多种恶性肿瘤的发生和发展。组蛋白乙酰转移酶（HAT）p300是一个关键的表观遗传调控因子，作为转录共激活因子，调控多种细胞过程。p300在乳腺癌中过表达，并促进细胞侵袭和存活，使其成为一个有前景的药物靶点。在本研究中，确立了p300在不同癌症通路中的相关性。通过分子对接 (molecular docking) 对FDA批准的药物库进行虚拟筛选，并识别出前10种潜在的药物再利用候选药物。进一步，在分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟后，使用分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积（MM-PBSA）方法重新计算了药物-p300复合物的结合自由能。基于分子动力学模拟参数和结合自由能分析，两种药物，即Netarsudil（-305.068 kJ/mol）和Imatinib（-260.457 kJ/mol），被确定为抑制p300活性的潜在再利用药物。总之，这些发现表明，Netarsudil和Imatinib可能通过抑制p300来对抗乳腺癌的潜在再利用药物。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
